ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Nmap/Zenmap Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of namp/zenmap. Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\nmap\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\zennmap\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "nmap\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "zennmap\.exe"))
